Name: Tiny Farmhouse 1.6
Author: clownedcat
Description:
This mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9721]Farmhouse by Robin's Vision[/url]. It's an edit of Jhoulana's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11926]My First Farmhouse with Kitchen[/url], originally published by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/164246303]badgerbadgerbadger13[/url]﻿. I simply updated this to work with the new 1.6 farmhouse extensions.

If Badger gets back to modding and updates their original files to work with 1.6 I will be deleting this page!

The Extended Corner Room, Attic, Cubby, and Dining room upgrades won't appear even if you buy them, so don't waste your money! These renovations are not required for achievements/perfection. I would recommend installing this on a new playthrough, as mid-save may rearrange your furniture in weird places with the second upgrade. The kitchen is not usable until you upgrade the farmhouse for the first time. The Corner Room and Southern Room are available as upgrades.

I haven't tested this with children.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url]﻿ by CyanFire.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

[b]Can you add/change ___ ?[/b]
No. This is a conversion, sorry! I am keeping this faithful to Badger's original vision; I will [b][u]not[/u][/b] be adding or changing anything.
You can always use the corner room and download furniture content packs to create an additional room to your heart's desire! I get requested bathrooms a lot, and while I don't intend on creating an extension or adding back the new house upgrades, I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17665]this [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26354]this[/url]﻿ to decorate. :)

[b]Why am I warping in the wrong place from my cellar?
[/b]If you're using a custom cellar mod, there may be warp issues. I've tried to address this in the content.json but it may not always work.
You'll have to edit your custom cellar warps in their .json files to:
      "Warp": "3 1 FarmHouse 30 31 4 1 FarmHouse 31 31"
Oh, and download ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url] please.

[b]Why did my cellar entrance / spouseroom disappear?[/b]
You need to download ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url]﻿. This is a vanilla issue.

[b]Can I have children?
[/b]I'm not the creator of this mod, so I don't know. Badger did not make this mod with children in mind so that's on you to test out.
Try raise the kid(s) in the crib (one at a time), and once they're toddlers remove the crib and build the corner room and buy + place the children bed(s) there so that the main bed could be in the top room. Maybe that might work!

[b]Why is my spouse in the void?[/b]
They will hang around in the void occasionally because technically the spouserooms (if disabled) and kitchen are beneath black tiles that hide them. They should be able to make their way around the house normally and other days they will spawn within the house or on the farm. Simply re-enable their rooms or go about your day. There's nothing I can do about this.
